code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    colors={v for row in out for v in row}
    bg=max(set(v for row in out for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in out))

    return out
